name: SmartVerses
tagline: Church presentations with live Scripture detection
description:
SmartVerses is a desktop church presentation platform for media teams preparing and running live worship services. It combines service presentation tools with live Bible verse detection, helping teams manage planned content and respond to Scripture mentioned during a sermon.

During a service, live transcription helps SmartVerses identify direct Bible references, quotations, and paraphrased passages. Detected verses go to the operator for review; a verse is sent to the main screen only after approval. SmartVerses can provide its own audience display as standalone presentation software. It can also work alongside an existing setup, including a native ProPresenter connection where supported through the ProPresenter API, or alongside software such as EasyWorship. Output options include NDI and Web Output.

For service preparation, its slide builder supports lyrics, Bible verses, announcements, media, countdowns, reusable layouts, and AI-assisted designs. The product also includes song and lyrics management, a media library, service timers, and schedule automation. Smart Recorder captures sermons and service segments. LiveVerses lets people in the congregation follow Scripture and slides on their phones and take sermon notes and summaries home, while the production team controls the main display. AI sermon notes and summaries are also available.

SmartVerses runs on Windows and macOS. A single-device free plan is available alongside paid plans; plan details are at https://www.smartverses.app/pricing.
